qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507.mistake: The equation \( 8 \div 2(2 + 2) \) is ambiguous due to the lack of explicit multiplication symbols and parentheses. According to standard order of operations (PEMDAS/BODMAS), division and multiplication have equal precedence and are evaluated left to right. Thus, \( 8 \div 2 \times (2 + 2) = 4 \times 4 = 16 \). However, some interpret \( 2(2 + 2) \) as implied multiplication with higher precedence, leading to \( 8 \div 8 = 1 \). This is not standard in formal mathematics. The correct evaluation under standard rules is 16, so claiming the answer is 1 is incorrect.
